3. Add tomatoes, yogurt and peas; cook until thick.
4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and whole spices; parboil soaked rice until 70 percent done; drain.
5. Layer half the rice in a heavy pot, then all the keema, then remaining rice.
6. Top with fried onion, mint, coriander, green chilies and saffron milk.
7. Cover tightly and cook on low dum for 20 minutes.
8. Gently fluff and serve hot.

title: Keema Naan
instructions:
1. Mix yeast, sugar and warm milk; rest 10 minutes.
2. Add flour, salt, yogurt and oil; knead into a soft dough; rest 1 hour.
3. Heat a pan, cook onion, ginger-garlic paste, beef mince, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala and salt until dry.
4. Stir in coriander and cool.
5. Divide dough into balls; flatten and place keema filling in center.
6. Seal edges and roll gently into an oval naan.
7. Cook on a hot tawa or bake in a hot oven until browned.
8. Brush with butter and serve hot.

title: Beef Keema Curry
instructions:
1. Heat oil and fry onion until golden.
2. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute.
3. Add beef mince and cook until no longer pink.
4. Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander, cumin, garam masala and salt; stir.
5. Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
6. Lower heat, stir in yogurt and cook 2 minutes.
7. Add water and green chilies; simmer 15-20 minutes until thick.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or roti.

title: Malai Kofta Curry
instructions:
1. Mix paneer, potatoes, cornstarch, green chili, coriander, garam masala and salt.
2. Shape into small balls and deep fry until golden; drain.
3. Heat ghee, fry onion until golden.
4. Add ginger-garlic paste, cashews and tomatoes; cook until soft.
5. Add coriander, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala and salt; cook 2 minutes.
6. Cool slightly, blend into a smooth gravy and strain if desired.
7. Return gravy to pan, add yogurt, water and sugar; simmer 5 minutes.
8. Add cream and kofta; simmer 3 minutes.
9. Garnish with coriander and serve with naan or rice.

title: Mughlai Malai
ingredients: 500 g halal chicken, boneless or bone-in
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chili powder and salt for 30 minutes.
2. Heat ghee and fry onion until golden.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste, cashews and melon seeds; cook 2 minutes.
4. Add marinated chicken and cook until browned.
5. Add 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer until chicken is tender.
6. Blend green chilies with a little water and add to pan.
7. Stir in cream, milk, garam masala and cardamom powder; simmer 5 minutes.
8. Finish with butter and coriander; serve with naan.

title: Nawabi Handi
ingredients: 700 g halal mutton, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Marinate mutton with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric and salt for 1 hour.
2. Heat ghee, add half the fried onions and marinated mutton; cook until browned.
3. Add 1 cup water, cover and pressure cook until mutton is tender.
4. Soak cashews and melon seeds in warm water, then blend into a smooth paste.
5. Add nut paste, green chilies, garam masala and cardamom powder to mutton; simmer 10 minutes.
6. Stir in cream, milk and kewra water; simmer 5 minutes.
7. Add remaining fried onions, coriander and mint.
8. Serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Mutton Dhansak
ingredients: 700 g halal mutton, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Soak all dals for 30 minutes; drain.
2. Pressure cook dals with pumpkin, potato, brinjal, turmeric and salt until soft; mash lightly.
3. Heat oil, add panch phoron and onion; fry until golden.
4. Add ginger-garlic paste, mutton, chili powder, coriander, cumin, dhansak masala and salt; cook until browned.
5. Add tomatoes and 1 cup water; pressure cook mutton until tender.
6. Combine cooked mutton with mashed dal mixture.
7. Add tamarind paste, jaggery and green chilies; simmer 15 minutes.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve with brown rice.

title: Chicken Dhaniya Curry
ingredients: 700 g halal chicken, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Blend coriander leaves, mint and green chilies with a little water into a paste.
2. Heat oil and fry onion until golden.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute.
4. Add chicken and cook until browned.
5. Add coriander powder, turmeric, chili powder, cumin and salt; stir.
6. Add yogurt and cook 2 minutes.
7. Add green paste and water; cover and simmer until chicken is tender.
8. Add garam masala and lemon juice; simmer 2 minutes.
9. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice.

title: Coriander Chicken
ingredients: 700 g halal chicken, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Blend coriander, mint and green chilies with 1/4 cup water into a smooth paste.
2. Heat oil and fry onion until golden.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute.
4. Add chicken and sear until lightly browned.
5. Add cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder and salt; stir.
6. Add yogurt and cook until oil separates.
7. Add green paste and water; simmer until chicken is tender.
8. Stir in garam masala and lemon juice.
9. Garnish with coriander and serve.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, black pepper and salt for 20 minutes.
2. Mix egg white, cornstarch and flour; coat chicken pieces.
3. Deep fry chicken in hot oil until golden and crisp; drain.
4. Heat 2 tbsp oil, stir-fry garlic, ginger, onion and bell pepper for 2 minutes.
5. Add lemon juice, soy sauce, honey, chili sauce and stock; simmer 2 minutes.
6. Add fried chicken and toss to coat.
7. Cook 2 minutes until sauce glazes chicken.
8. Garnish with lemon slices and spring onions; serve hot.

title: Ginger Chicken
ingredients: 600 g halal chicken, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Heat oil and fry onion until golden.
2. Add ginger-garlic paste and half the julienned ginger; cook 1 minute.
3. Add chicken and cook until browned.
4. Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder and salt; stir.
5. Add yogurt and cook until oil separates.
6. Add water and green chilies; cover and simmer until chicken is tender.
7. Add garam masala and remaining ginger; cook 3 minutes.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve with roti or rice.

title: Black Pepper Chicken
ingredients: 600 g halal chicken, cut into pieces
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chili powder and salt for 20 minutes.
2. Heat oil and sear chicken until browned; remove.
3. Add ginger, garlic, onion, bell pepper, green chilies and curry leaves; stir-fry 2 minutes.
4. Return chicken to pan.
5. Add black pepper, soy sauce, vinegar and stock; simmer 10 minutes.
6. Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until sauce thickens.
7. Adjust salt and cook 2 minutes.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve hot with rice.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 500 g boneless halal chicken breast, cubed
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with soy sauce, rice vinegar, cornstarch, and sesame oil for 15 minutes.
2. Mix sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside.
3. Heat wok with vegetable oil, fry dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns for 20 seconds.
4. Add chicken and stir-fry until golden and cooked through.
5. Add garlic, ginger, and white parts of scallions; stir-fry 30 seconds.
6. Pour in sauce and simmer until glossy and thickened.
7. Stir in roasted peanuts and green scallion parts.
8. Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
instructions:
1. Cut chicken into bite-sized cubes and pat dry.
2. Whisk egg, cornstarch, flour, and salt into a batter; coat chicken.
3. Heat oil and fry chicken until crispy and golden; drain.
4. In a wok, stir-fry onion, bell pepper, and carrot for 2 minutes.
5. Add ketchup, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, water, and cornstarch; simmer until thickened.
6. Add pineapple chunks and cook 1 minute.
7. Toss fried chicken into sauce until coated.
8. Serve immediately with rice.

title: General Tso Chicken
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with egg, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil for 15 minutes.
2. Coat chicken pieces in cornstarch.
3. Heat oil and fry chicken until crisp; drain on paper towels.
4. Mix sauce ingredients in a bowl.
5. In a wok, stir-fry dried chilies, garlic, and ginger for 30 seconds.
6. Add sauce and simmer until slightly thickened.
7. Toss fried chicken in sauce until well coated.
8. Garnish with scallions and serve with rice.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Dice chicken and season lightly with salt.
2. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok and scramble eggs; remove.
3. Add remaining oil and stir-fry chicken until cooked through.
4. Add garlic, carrot, and peas; stir-fry 2 minutes.
5. Add cooled rice and break up clumps.
6. Add soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper, and salt; toss well.
7. Return scrambled eggs and add scallions.
8. Toss for 1 minute and serve hot.

title: Schezwan Noodles
instructions:
1. Boil noodles according to package directions; drain and set aside.
2. Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry chicken until browned.
3. Add garlic, ginger, and onion; stir-fry 1 minute.
4. Add carrot and bell pepper; cook 2 minutes.
5. Add Schezwan sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar.
6. Add noodles and chicken stock; toss over high heat.
7. Cook until sauce coats noodles evenly.
8. Garnish with scallions and serve hot.

title: Singapore Rice Noodles
instructions:
1. Soak rice vermicelli in warm water until soft; drain.
2. Heat 1 tbsp oil and scramble eggs; remove.
3. Add remaining oil and stir-fry chicken and prawns until cooked.
4. Add garlic, ginger, and onion; stir-fry 1 minute.
5. Add curry powder and bell pepper; cook 1 minute.
6. Add noodles, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and chicken stock.
7. Toss over high heat until noodles are coated and hot.
8. Fold in scrambled eggs and scallions; serve.

title: Chow Mein
instructions:
1. Boil noodles until just tender; drain and rinse.
2. Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry chicken until golden.
3. Add garlic, ginger, and onion; stir-fry 1 minute.
4. Add cabbage and carrot; cook 2 minutes.
5. Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, chicken stock, and cornstarch; pour into wok.
6. Add noodles and toss until sauce thickens.
7. Add bean sprouts and toss 1 minute.
8. Serve hot.

title: Egg Chowmein
instructions:
1. Boil noodles until tender; drain and set aside.
2. Heat 1 tbsp oil and scramble eggs; remove.
3. Add remaining oil and stir-fry garlic and onion for 1 minute.
4. Add cabbage and carrot; stir-fry 2 minutes.
5. Add soy sauce, chili sauce, sugar, and water; bring to a simmer.
6. Add noodles and toss until well coated.
7. Fold in scrambled eggs and scallions.
8. Toss for 1 minute and serve hot.

title: Szechuan Mutton
instructions:
1. Marinate mutton with soy sauce, rice vinegar, and cornstarch for 20 minutes.
2. Heat wok with oil and fry dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns for 20 seconds.
3. Add mutton and sear over high heat until browned.
4. Add garlic, ginger, and doubanjiang; stir-fry 1 minute.
5. Add onion and bell pepper; cook 2 minutes.
6. Pour in mutton stock and simmer until mutton is tender.
7. Add scallions and toss.
8. Serve hot with rice.

title: Bunter Chicken Salad
instructions:
1. Boil chicken until cooked, then shred; boil potatoes, carrot, peas, and eggs.
2. Dice potatoes, carrot, and eggs; place in a large bowl.
3. Mix mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, black pepper, chaat masala, and salt.
4. Add shredded chicken, potatoes, carrot, peas, and eggs to the bowl.
5. Add cucumber, tomato, onion, green chilies, and coriander.
6. Fold in the dressing until evenly combined.
7. Chill for 30 minutes.
8. Serve cold as a salad or side.

title: Thai Chicken Curry
instructions:
1. Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
2. Heat oil in a pot and fry red curry paste for 1 minute.
3. Add coconut milk and chicken stock; stir well.
4. Add chicken and simmer for 10 minutes.
5. Add eggplant, bell pepper, and bamboo shoots.
6. Add fish sauce, palm sugar, and kaffir lime leaves.
7. Simmer until chicken and vegetables are tender.
8. Stir in Thai basil and serve with rice.

title: Thai Chilli Beef
ingredients: 500 g halal beef sirloin, thinly sliced
instructions:
1. Slice beef thinly against the grain.
2. Heat wok with oil and sear beef over high heat; remove.
3. Stir-fry garlic, chilies, onion, and bell pepper for 2 minutes.
4. Return beef to the wok.
5. Add fish sauce, soy sauce, palm sugar, and beef stock.
6. Toss over high heat until sauce coats beef.
7. Add lime juice and Thai basil.
8. Toss briefly and serve hot.

title: Penang Chicken Curry
instructions:
1. Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and boil potatoes.
2. Heat oil in a pot and fry Penang curry paste for 1 minute.
3. Add coconut milk and chicken stock; stir to combine.
4. Add chicken and simmer for 12 minutes.
5. Add potatoes, peanuts, and kaffir lime leaves.
6. Add fish sauce and palm sugar.
7. Simmer until chicken is tender and sauce thickens.
8. Stir in Thai basil and serve with rice.

title: Tom Yum Soup
instructions:
1. Bruise lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves.
2. Bring chicken stock to a boil with aromatics; simmer 10 minutes.
3. Add mushrooms and tomatoes; cook 3 minutes.
4. Add prawns and cook until pink.
5. Add fish sauce and chili paste.
6. Simmer 2 minutes.
7. Add lime juice, red chilies, and coriander.
8. Serve hot.

title: Laksa
instructions:
1. Boil rice noodles and eggs; drain noodles and peel eggs.
2. Heat a pot and fry laksa paste for 1 minute.
3. Add chicken stock and coconut milk; bring to a simmer.
4. Add chicken and simmer until cooked.
5. Add prawns and tofu puffs; cook 3 minutes.
6. Add fish sauce and lime juice.
7. Place noodles in bowls and ladle soup over them.
8. Top with bean sprouts, boiled eggs, and coriander.

title: Nasi Goreng
instructions:
1. Chop chicken and prawns into small pieces.
2. Blend shallots, garlic, and red chilies into a paste.
3. Heat 1 tbsp oil and scramble eggs; remove.
4. Add remaining oil and fry the paste until fragrant.
5. Add chicken and prawns; stir-fry until cooked.
6. Add rice, sweet soy sauce, soy sauce, and shrimp paste; toss well.
7. Fold in scrambled eggs.
8. Serve with cucumber, tomatoes, and fried shallots.

title: Bihari Kabab
ingredients: 500 g halal beef sirloin, thinly sliced
instructions:
1. Tenderize beef with raw papaya paste for 30 minutes.
2. Mix yogurt, fried onions, ginger garlic paste, spices, mustard oil, chickpea flour, salt, and lemon juice.
3. Coat beef well and marinate for 4 hours.
4. Thread beef onto skewers.
5. Grill or pan-sear for 5 to 7 minutes per side.
6. Baste with a little oil while cooking.
7. Rest for 5 minutes.
8. Serve with naan and chutney.

title: Beef Tikka
instructions:
1. Mix yogurt, ginger garlic paste, spices, lemon juice, mustard oil, gram flour, and salt.
2. Add beef cubes and coat well.
3. Marinate for 4 hours or overnight.
4. Thread beef onto skewers.
5. Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning occasionally.
6. Baste with oil or marinade while grilling.
7. Cook until beef is tender and charred at edges.
8. Rest and serve with mint chutney.

title: Mutton Raan
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron soaked in 2 tbsp milk
instructions:
1. Prick mutton leg all over with a fork.
2. Mix yogurt, ginger garlic paste, spices, papaya paste, fried onions, mustard oil, lemon juice, salt, and saffron milk.
3. Coat mutton with marinade and refrigerate overnight.
4. Preheat oven to 180C.
5. Place mutton in a roasting pan and cover with foil.
6. Roast for 2 hours.
7. Uncover, baste with pan juices, and roast 30 minutes until browned.
8. Rest for 10 minutes, then slice and serve.

title: Chicken Raan
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron soaked in 2 tbsp milk
instructions:
1. Prick chicken pieces all over.
2. Mix yogurt, ginger garlic paste, spices, papaya paste, fried onions, mustard oil, lemon juice, salt, and saffron milk.
3. Coat chicken and marinate for 6 hours.
4. Preheat oven to 200C.
5. Place chicken on a rack over a baking tray.
6. Roast for 45 minutes.
7. Baste with marinade and roast 15 minutes more until browned.
8. Rest and serve with naan.

title: Kachchi Mutton Biryani
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron soaked in 1/4 cup milk
Whole spices: 2 bay leaves, 4 cloves, 4 cardamom, 1 cinnamon stick, 1 tsp cumin
instructions:
1. Marinate mutton with yogurt, fried onions, ginger garlic paste, spices, herbs, green chilies, ghee, and salt for 4 hours.
2. Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes.
3. Boil rice with whole spices and salt until 70 percent cooked; drain.
4. Layer marinated mutton and potatoes in a heavy pot.
5. Top with partially cooked rice.
6. Add saffron milk, mint, coriander, and remaining ghee.
7. Seal pot and cook on low heat for 45 minutes.
8. Rest 10 minutes, fluff gently, and serve.

title: Morog Biryani
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron soaked in 1/4 cup milk
Whole spices: 2 bay leaves, 4 cloves, 4 cardamom, 1 cinnamon stick
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with yogurt, fried onions, ginger garlic paste, spices, herbs, green chilies, ghee, and salt for 2 hours.
2. Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes.
3. Boil rice with whole spices and salt until 70 percent cooked; drain.
4. Layer marinated chicken and potatoes in a heavy pot.
5. Top with partially cooked rice.
6. Add saffron milk, kewra water, mint, coriander, and ghee.
7. Seal and cook on low heat for 30 minutes.
8. Rest, fluff, and serve.

title: Dhaka Style Biryani
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron soaked in 1/4 cup milk
Whole spices: 2 bay leaves, 4 cloves, 4 cardamom, 1 cinnamon stick
instructions:
1. Marinate mutton with yogurt, fried onions, ginger garlic paste, spices, and salt for 4 hours.
2. Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes.
3. Boil rice with whole spices and salt until 70 percent cooked; drain.
4. Layer mutton, potatoes, and prunes in a heavy pot.
5. Top with partially cooked rice.
6. Add saffron milk, kewra water, mint, coriander, green chilies, and ghee.
7. Seal and cook on low heat for 45 minutes.
8. Rest 10 minutes, fluff, and serve.

title: Chicken Jahangir's Feast
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron soaked in 1/4 cup milk
Whole spices: 2 bay leaves, 4 cloves, 4 cardamom, 1 cinnamon stick
instructions:
1. Soak almonds and cashews in warm water, then blend into a smooth paste.
2. Marinate chicken with yogurt, fried onions, ginger garlic paste, spices, and salt for 2 hours.
3. Heat ghee in a heavy pot and add whole spices.
4. Add marinated chicken and cook until sealed and lightly browned.
5. Add almond-cashew paste and simmer until chicken is tender.
6. Stir in cream and saffron milk.
7. Cook until oil separates and gravy is rich.
8. Garnish with green chilies and coriander; serve with naan.

title: Mughlai Handi Biryani
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron soaked in 1/4 cup milk
Whole spices: 2 bay leaves, 4 cloves, 4 cardamom, 1 cinnamon stick
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with yogurt, fried onions, ginger garlic paste, spices, and salt for 2 hours.
2. Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes.
3. Boil rice with whole spices and salt until 70 percent cooked; drain.
4. Cook marinated chicken in a handi until half done.
5. Layer partially cooked rice over the chicken.
6. Add cream, saffron milk, mint, coriander, green chilies, and ghee.
7. Seal the handi and cook on low heat for 30 minutes.
8. Rest 10 minutes, fluff gently, and serve.

title: Lucknowi Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 1 kg chicken, bone-in, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, red chili, turmeric, garam masala, biryani masala, salt, half fried onions, mint, coriander, and green chilies for 1 hour.
2. Boil 8 cups water with bay leaves, cloves, black cardamom, cinnamon, cumin, and salt. Add soaked rice and cook until 70 percent done. Drain.
3. Heat ghee in a heavy pot. Add marinated chicken and cook on medium heat for 10 minutes until partially cooked.
4. Layer parboiled rice over chicken. Sprinkle saffron milk, rose water, kewra water, remaining fried onions, mint, and coriander.
5. Seal pot with foil or dough. Cook on low heat for 25 minutes.
6. Turn off heat and rest 10 minutes. Open gently and fluff with a fork.
7. Serve hot with raita or salad.

title: Kerala Beef Fry
ingredients: 500 g beef, cut into small cubes
instructions:
1. Pressure cook beef with turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp black pepper, vinegar, and salt until tender. Reserve stock.
2. Heat coconut oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Let them splutter.
3. Add onions, green chilies, and coconut slices. Fry until onions are golden.
4. Add fennel seeds, coriander powder, red chili powder, and remaining black pepper. Stir for 1 minute.
5. Add cooked beef and 1/4 cup reserved stock. Mix well.
6. Fry on medium-high heat until beef is dark, dry, and coated with masala.
7. Garnish with more curry leaves and serve with porotta or rice.

title: Kerala Porotta
ingredients: 1/2 cup water, plus more as needed
Extra oil for brushing and cooking
instructions:
1. Mix flour, sugar, salt, egg, oil, and milk. Add water gradually and knead into a soft dough.
2. Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and rest 1 hour.
3. Divide dough into 8 balls. Roll each ball into a very thin circle.
4. Brush generously with oil. Pleat the circle like a fan, then roll into a spiral.
5. Rest spirals 15 minutes. Flatten each spiral into a thick circle.
6. Cook on a hot tawa or griddle until bubbles appear. Flip and cook the other side.
7. Brush with oil and slap the porotta between hands or press with a spatula to separate layers.
8. Serve hot with curry or beef fry.

title: Malabar Beef Curry
instructions:
1. Pressure cook beef with turmeric, salt, and 1/2 cup water until tender. Set aside.
2. Heat coconut oil. Add mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, and curry leaves.
3. Add onions, green chilies, and ginger-garlic paste. Fry until onions are soft.
4. Add tomatoes, coriander powder, red chili powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes break down.
5. Add cooked beef and its stock. Simmer 10 minutes.
6. Pour in coconut milk and simmer gently for 5 minutes without boiling hard.
7. Stir in garam masala. Garnish with curry leaves and serve with rice or porotta.

title: Chicken Suqaar
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pan. Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until fragrant.
2. Add chicken cubes and cook until lightly browned.
3. Add cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili, and salt. Stir well.
4. Add bell peppers and tomatoes. Cook 5 minutes.
5. Pour in water and simmer 10 minutes until chicken is cooked and sauce thickens.
6. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with rice, flatbread, or salad.

title: Somali Suqaar
ingredients: 500 g beef, cut into small cubes
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pan. Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until soft.
2. Add beef cubes and brown on all sides.
3. Add cumin, coriander, turmeric, cardamom, red chili, and salt. Stir for 1 minute.
4. Add tomato and green bell pepper. Cook 5 minutes.
5. Add water, cover, and simmer 20 minutes until beef is tender.
6. Uncover and cook until sauce is thick and glossy.
7. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with Somali bariis or flatbread.

title: Somali Bariis
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pot. Brown meat on all sides. Remove and set aside.
2. Add onion and sauté until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and whole spices.
3. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
4. Return meat to pot. Add water and simmer 30 minutes until meat is tender.
5. Add rinsed rice and stir. Add more water if needed to cover rice by 1 inch.
6. Cover and cook on low heat 20 minutes until rice is fluffy.
7. Fluff with fork, garnish with cilantro, and serve.

title: Camel Meat Curry
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pressure cooker or heavy pot. Brown camel meat in batches.
2. Add onions, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until soft and fragrant.
3. Add curry powder, turmeric, red chili, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom, and bay leaves. Stir 1 minute.
4. Add tomatoes and salt. Cook until tomatoes soften.
5. Return meat to pot. Add water. Pressure cook 40 minutes or simmer covered 2 hours until tender.
6. Uncover and simmer until sauce thickens.
7. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with rice or flatbread.

title: Sudanese Fasuliya
ingredients: 2 cups dried white beans, soaked overnight
instructions:
1. Drain soaked beans. Heat oil in a pot and brown meat.
2. Add onion and garlic. Sauté until soft.
3. Stir in tomato paste, tomatoes, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, red chili, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
4. Add beans and water. Bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 1 hour until beans and meat are tender.
6. Mash a few beans against the pot to thicken the stew. Simmer 10 more minutes.
7. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with rice or bread.

title: Egyptian Koshari
ingredients: 1/4 cup water for garlic vinegar sauce
instructions:
1. Cook lentils in salted water until tender but not mushy. Drain.
2. Cook rice with vermicelli in salted water until fluffy. Cook macaroni separately. Warm chickpeas.
3. Fry sliced onions in oil until dark golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels.
4. Make tomato sauce: sauté 2 minced garlic in a little oil, add tomato sauce, cumin, red chili, salt, and simmer 10 minutes.
5. Make garlic vinegar sauce: simmer 3 garlic cloves with vinegar and water for 5 minutes.
6. Layer rice, lentils, macaroni, and chickpeas in a bowl.
7. Top with tomato sauce, garlic vinegar sauce, and fried onions. Serve warm.

title: Kabsa
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a large pot. Brown chicken pieces on both sides. Remove and set aside.
2. Add onion and sauté until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and whole spices.
3. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, kabsa spice, turmeric, cinnamon, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
4. Return chicken to pot. Add water and simmer 25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
5. Remove chicken and keep warm. Add rinsed rice to the broth. Add more water if needed.
6. Cover and cook rice on low heat 20 minutes until fluffy.
7. Broil or pan-sear chicken until browned. Serve over rice with raisins and almonds.

title: Mandi
instructions:
1. Marinate meat with yogurt, lemon juice, mandi spice, turmeric, coriander, cumin, cardamom, and salt for 1 hour.
2. Heat oil in a pot. Add onion and bay leaves. Sauté until soft.
3. Add marinated meat and cook until browned.
4. Add water and simmer until meat is tender. Remove meat and keep warm.
5. Add rinsed rice to the broth. Add more water if needed to cover rice by 1 inch.
6. Cover and cook rice on low heat 20 minutes until fluffy.
7. Grill or broil meat until browned. Serve over rice.

title: Machboos
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pot. Brown chicken pieces. Remove and set aside.
2. Add onions, cloves, cardamom, and bay leaves. Sauté until onions soften.
3. Add tomatoes, baharat, turmeric, cinnamon, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
4. Return chicken to pot. Add water and dried lime. Simmer 25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
5. Remove chicken and keep warm. Add rinsed rice to the broth.
6. Cover and cook rice on low heat 20 minutes until fluffy.
7. Return chicken on top of rice, steam 5 minutes, garnish with cilantro, and serve.

title: Harees
ingredients: 2 cups wheat berries for harees, soaked overnight
instructions:
1. Drain soaked wheat berries. In a large pot, combine wheat, meat, onion, cinnamon, cumin, salt, pepper, and water.
2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 2 hours until wheat and meat are very soft.
3. Stir occasionally and add more water if needed to prevent sticking.
4. Remove from heat. Mash with a potato masher or blend briefly until porridge-like but still textured.
5. Return to low heat and stir in ghee. Simmer 10 minutes.
6. Adjust salt. Serve warm in bowls, optionally with extra ghee on top.

title: Umb 3admat
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a heavy pot. Brown lamb shanks on all sides.
2. Add onions, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until fragrant.
3. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, red chili, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
4. Add water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 1.5 hours until lamb is tender.
5. Add okra and cook 20 minutes until soft.
6. Stir in peanut butter and simmer 10 minutes until stew thickens.
7. Adjust salt. Serve with rice, kisra, or flatbread.

title: Sorba
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pot. Brown lamb cubes.
2. Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until soft.
3. Add tomatoes, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
4. Add water and bring to a boil. Simmer 1 hour until lamb is tender.
5. Add carrot and potato. Cook 15 minutes until vegetables are soft.
6. Add vermicelli and cook 5 minutes until tender.
7. Garnish with cilantro and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Batter Fried Fish
ingredients: 500 g white fish fillets, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. In a bowl, mix all-purpose flour, rice flour, baking powder, red chili, turmeric, and salt.
2. Add egg and cold water. Whisk into a smooth batter similar to pancake batter.
3. Pat fish pieces dry. Dip each piece into batter, coating well.
4. Heat oil in a deep pan to 180 C.
5. Fry fish in batches for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crisp.
6. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with extra salt if desired.
7. Serve hot with lemon wedges and chutney or sauce.

title: Fish Tikka
ingredients: 500 g firm white fish fillets, cubed
instructions:
1. In a bowl, mix yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, red chili, turmeric, garam masala, cumin, coriander, oil, and salt.
2. Add fish cubes and coat gently. Marinate 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
3. Thread fish onto skewers or place on a lined baking tray.
4. Grill or bake at 220 C for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once.
5. Baste with a little oil halfway through.
6. Cook until fish is opaque and slightly charred at edges.
7. Sprinkle chaat masala and serve with lemon and onion rings.

title: Tuna Sandwiches
instructions:
1. In a bowl, flake tuna with a fork.
2. Add mayonnaise, mustard, celery, red onion, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
3. Toast bread slices lightly if desired.
4. Spread tuna mixture on 4 slices of bread.
5. Top with lettuce and tomato slices.
6. Close with remaining bread slices.
7. Cut in half and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Club Sandwich
instructions:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Grill or pan-cook until fully done. Slice.
2. Boil eggs, peel, and slice. Toast bread slices with a little butter.
3. Spread mayonnaise on one side of each toast.
4. On first slice, layer lettuce, tomato, grilled chicken, and cheese.
5. Add second slice of toast. Layer egg slices, lettuce, tomato, and a little salt and pepper.
6. Top with third slice of toast. Press gently.
7. Cut into triangles and secure with toothpicks. Serve.

title: Beef Burger
instructions:
1. In a bowl, mix ground beef, grated onion, garlic, salt, pepper, cumin, paprika, egg, and breadcrumbs.
2. Shape into 4 equal patties. Chill 15 minutes.
3. Grill or pan-fry patties 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through.
4. Top each patty with cheese during the last minute.
5. Toast burger buns lightly.
6. Spread mayonnaise and ketchup on buns. Add lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and patty.
7. Close burgers and serve hot.

title: Chicken Burger
instructions:
1. Mix ground chicken, grated onion, garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, egg, and breadcrumbs.
2. Form into 4 patties. Chill 15 minutes.
3. Cook patties in a lightly oiled pan or grill 5 to 6 minutes per side until fully cooked.
4. Toast burger buns.
5. Spread mayonnaise and ketchup on buns.
6. Add lettuce, tomato, and chicken patty.
7. Close burgers and serve hot.

title: Nachos
instructions:
1. Cook ground beef in a pan until browned. Add taco seasoning and 2 tbsp water. Simmer 3 minutes.
2. Warm black beans in a small pot.
3. Spread tortilla chips on a baking tray.
4. Top with cooked beef, black beans, and cheddar cheese.
5. Bake at 200 C for 5 to 7 minutes until cheese melts.
6. Remove and top with salsa, sour cream, jalapeño, and cilantro.
7. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Wings BBQ
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200 C. Pat chicken wings dry.
2. Toss wings with oil, salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
3. Arrange wings on a lined baking tray in a single layer.
4. Bake 30 minutes, turning once halfway.
5. Mix BBQ sauce, honey, and lemon juice in a bowl.
6. Brush wings generously with BBQ sauce. Bake 10 more minutes.
7. Broil 2 minutes for char. Serve hot.

title: Buffalo Wings
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200 C. Pat chicken wings dry.
2. Toss wings with oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
3. Arrange on a lined baking tray. Bake 35 minutes, turning once.
4. In a small pot, melt butter with hot sauce, vinegar, and paprika. Stir until combined.
5. Transfer baked wings to a large bowl.
6. Pour buffalo sauce over wings and toss until fully coated.
7. Serve with celery sticks and halal ranch dressing.

title: Chicken Satay
ingredients: 500 g boneless chicken thighs, cut into strips
Peanut sauce: 1/2 cup smooth peanut butter
Peanut sauce: 2 tbsp halal soy sauce
instructions:
1. In a bowl, mix soy sauce, fish sauce, honey, turmeric, coriander, cumin, ginger garlic paste, chili flakes, coconut milk, and oil.
2. Add chicken strips and coat well. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight.
3. Thread marinated chicken onto soaked bamboo skewers, leaving small gaps.
4. Preheat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat and lightly oil.
5. Grill skewers 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through and lightly charred.
6. For peanut sauce, combine peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, tamarind, brown sugar, chili paste, garlic, and water in a small saucepan.
7. Cook over low heat, stirring, until smooth and thickened, about 5 minutes.
8. Serve chicken satay hot with peanut sauce.

title: Chicken Tempura
ingredients: 400 g chicken breast, cut into 1 cm strips
Dipping sauce: 1/4 cup halal soy sauce
instructions:
1. Pat chicken strips dry and season lightly with salt.
2. In a bowl, whisk flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and salt.
3. Add ice-cold sparkling water and egg; whisk just until combined and lumpy. Keep batter cold.
4. Heat 3 inches of oil in a deep pan to 175 C.
5. Dip chicken strips in batter, letting excess drip off.
6. Fry in batches for 3-4 minutes until golden and cooked through.
7. Drain on paper towels.
8. Mix dipping sauce ingredients and serve with hot tempura.

title: Chicken Karaage
ingredients: 500 g boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine soy sauce, ginger juice, garlic paste, sugar, salt, pepper, rice vinegar, and egg.
2. Add chicken pieces and mix well. Marinate for 30 minutes.
3. In another bowl, mix cornstarch and flour.
4. Heat oil to 170 C in a deep pan.
5. Dredge each chicken piece in cornstarch-flour mixture, pressing lightly.
6. Fry in batches for 4-5 minutes until golden and crisp.
7. Increase oil to 180 C and fry again for 1 minute for extra crispness.
8. Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Japanese Curry Rice
ingredients: 500 g boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
instructions:
1. Rinse rice until water runs clear, then cook with 3 cups water in a rice cooker or covered pot.
2. Heat oil in a large pot and brown chicken on all sides. Remove and set aside.
3. Add onions and cook until soft and golden.
4. Add butter, flour, curry powder, garam masala, and turmeric; cook 1 minute.
5. Gradually whisk in chicken stock until smooth.
6. Add carrots, potatoes, browned chicken, soy sauce, honey, and grated apple.
7. Simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender and curry thickens.
8. Season with salt. Serve hot over steamed rice.

title: Tonkatsu
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts or beef cutlets, pounded to 1 cm thick
instructions:
1. Season chicken or beef cutlets with salt and pepper.
2. Set up three plates with flour, beaten eggs, and panko.
3. Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing crumbs firmly.
4. Heat 1 inch of oil in a skillet to 170 C.
5. Fry cutlets 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
6. Drain on paper towels and rest 2 minutes.
7. Mix ketchup, soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and ginger for sauce.
8. Slice cutlets and serve with sauce and shredded cabbage.

title: Menchi Katsu
ingredients: Tonkatsu sauce or ketchup for serving
instructions:
1. In a bowl, mix beef mince, onion, egg, 1/2 cup panko, salt, pepper, and nutmeg until sticky.
2. Shape into 8 oval patties.
3. Chill patties for 15 minutes to firm up.
4. Coat each patty in flour, then beaten egg, then panko.
5. Heat oil to 170 C in a deep pan.
6. Fry patties in batches for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
7. Drain on paper towels.
8. Serve hot with tonkatsu sauce or ketchup.

title: Yakitori
ingredients: 500 g boneless chicken thighs, cut into 2 cm cubes
1 bunch scallions, cut into 2 cm pieces
instructions:
1. In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, water, brown sugar, rice vinegar, honey, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil.
2. Simmer over low heat for 5-7 minutes until slightly thickened. Set aside half for basting and half for serving.
3. Thread chicken and scallions alternately onto soaked skewers.
4. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high and lightly oil.
5. Grill skewers 3 minutes, then brush with sauce.
6. Turn and grill another 3-4 minutes, basting again, until chicken is cooked through.
7. Brush once more with fresh sauce and grill 1 minute.
8. Serve hot with remaining sauce.

title: Korokke
instructions:
1. Mash boiled potatoes in a large bowl.
2. Heat oil in a pan and cook onion until soft.
3. Add beef mince, salt, pepper, and nutmeg; cook until browned.
4. Mix beef mixture into mashed potatoes and cool completely.
5. Shape into 8 oval croquettes.
6. Coat each in flour, then egg, then panko.
7. Heat oil to 175 C and fry croquettes in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Drain on paper towels and serve with tonkatsu sauce.

title: Onigiri
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked chicken or canned tuna, flaked
instructions:
1. Rinse rice until water runs clear.
2. Cook rice with 2 1/2 cups water in a rice cooker or covered pot.
3. Let rice cool until safe to handle.
4. Mix chicken or tuna with mayonnaise, soy sauce, and sesame seeds.
5. Wet hands and rub with salt.
6. Take a handful of rice, make a well, add filling, and seal rice around it.
7. Shape into triangle or ball, pressing firmly.
8. Wrap with nori strip and serve with pickled vegetables.

title: Miso Soup
instructions:
1. Wipe kombu with a damp cloth and place in a pot with water.
2. Soak shiitake in the water for 20 minutes.
3. Heat gently until almost boiling, then remove kombu before boiling.
4. Add shiitake and simmer 5 minutes.
5. Add tofu and wakame; simmer 2 minutes.
6. Ladle some hot broth into a bowl and whisk in miso paste until smooth.
7. Pour miso mixture back into pot; do not boil after adding miso.
8. Taste and add soy sauce if desired.
9. Garnish with scallions and serve hot.

title: Katsudon
instructions:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper.
2. Coat chicken in flour, then egg, then panko.
3. Heat oil to 170 C and fry chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked. Drain and slice.
4. In a small pan, combine dashi, soy sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar; bring to a simmer.
5. Add onion and cook 3 minutes until softened.
6. Place sliced chicken on top and pour beaten eggs around it.
7. Cover and cook 1-2 minutes until eggs are just set.
8. Serve over hot rice and garnish with scallions.

title: Gyudon
instructions:
1. In a bowl, mix soy sauce, water, brown sugar, rice vinegar, honey, ginger, and garlic.
2. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
3. Add onion and cook until soft and lightly golden.
4. Add beef slices and cook 2 minutes until no longer pink.
5. Pour in sauce mixture and simmer 5-7 minutes until beef is tender and sauce reduces.
6. Taste and adjust sweetness or salt.
7. Serve beef and onion over hot rice.
8. Garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.

title: Beef Teriyaki
instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, honey, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over high heat.
3. Sear beef slices in a single layer for 1-2 minutes per side.
4. Remove beef and set aside.
5. Pour sauce into the skillet and simmer 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
6. Return beef to skillet and toss to coat for 1 minute.
7. Garnish with sesame seeds and scallions.
8. Serve hot with steamed rice or vegetables.

title: Chicken Teriyaki
ingredients: 500 g boneless chicken thighs, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, honey, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add chicken and cook 5-6 minutes until browned on all sides.
4. Pour sauce over chicken and simmer 5-7 minutes until chicken is cooked and sauce glazes.
5. Turn chicken to coat evenly.
6. Cook 1 more minute until sauce is thick and glossy.
7. Garnish with sesame seeds and scallions.
8. Serve hot with rice.

title: Beef Udon
instructions:
1. Cook udon noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside.
2. In a pot, combine beef stock, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, honey, ginger, and garlic; bring to a simmer.
3. Add beef slices and simmer 5 minutes until cooked.
4. Add cabbage and carrot; cook 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
5. Add cooked udon noodles and sesame oil; heat through 2 minutes.
6. Taste and adjust seasoning.
7. Ladle into bowls.
8. Garnish with scallions and serve hot.

title: Chicken Ramen
instructions:
1. Boil eggs for 7 minutes, cool in ice water, peel, and halve.
2. In a pot, combine chicken stock, water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil.
3. Bring to a simmer and add chicken slices.
4. Cook chicken 5-6 minutes until cooked through.
5. Add spinach and cook 1 minute.
6. Cook ramen noodles separately according to package directions, then drain.
7. Divide noodles into bowls and ladle hot broth, chicken, and spinach over them.
8. Top with egg halves, scallions, and nori. Serve hot.

title: Beef Ramen
instructions:
1. Boil eggs for 7 minutes, cool in ice water, peel, and halve.
2. In a pot, combine beef stock, water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil.
3. Bring to a simmer and add beef slices.
4. Cook beef 3-4 minutes until just cooked.
5. Add bok choy and cook 2 minutes.
6. Cook ramen noodles separately according to package directions, then drain.
7. Divide noodles into bowls and ladle hot broth, beef, and bok choy over them.
8. Top with egg halves, scallions, and nori. Serve hot.

title: Vegetarian Ramen
instructions:
1. In a pot, combine vegetable stock, water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil.
2. Bring to a simmer.
3. Add tofu, mushrooms, bok choy, and carrot.
4. Simmer 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender.
5. Cook ramen noodles separately according to package directions, then drain.
6. Divide noodles into bowls.
7. Ladle hot broth and vegetables over noodles.
8. Garnish with scallions and nori. Serve hot.

title: Okonomiyaki
ingredients: 200 g boneless chicken thigh, thinly sliced
1/2 cup tenkasu or crushed panko, optional
Bonito flakes and aonori for garnish, optional
instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk flour, dashi or water, and eggs until smooth.
2. Fold in cabbage, scallions, and tenkasu or panko.
3. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
4. Pour half the batter into the skillet and top with half the chicken slices.
5. Cook 4-5 minutes until bottom is set and golden.
6. Flip carefully and cook another 4-5 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
7. Repeat with remaining batter and chicken.
8. Mix ketchup, soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and ginger for sauce.
9. Drizzle sauce and mayonnaise over pancakes.
10. Garnish with bonito flakes and aonori if using, then serve.

title: Korokke Curry
instructions:
1. Mash boiled potatoes.
2. Heat oil and cook onion until soft.
3. Add beef mince, salt, pepper, and nutmeg; cook until browned.
4. Mix into mashed potatoes, cool, shape into 8 croquettes.
5. Coat croquettes in flour, egg, then panko.
6. Heat oil to 175 C and fry croquettes until golden, about 3-4 minutes. Drain.
7. For curry, melt butter, cook onion until soft, add flour, curry powder, and garam masala; cook 1 minute.
8. Whisk in beef stock, add soy sauce, honey, carrot, and potato; simmer 20 minutes.
9. Serve croquettes over rice with curry ladled around.

title: Nabe Chinese Cabbageundle
ingredients: 2 tbsp halal soy sauce for broth
instructions:
1. Blanch cabbage leaves in boiling water for 1 minute until pliable; drain and cool.
2. Mix chicken mince, cooked rice, egg, soy sauce, ginger, and scallions.
3. Place a spoonful of filling on each cabbage leaf, fold sides in, and roll tightly.
4. In a wide pot, combine chicken stock, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar; bring to a simmer.
5. Add carrot, mushrooms, and tofu.
6. Arrange cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot.
7. Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes until chicken filling is cooked through.
8. Taste broth and add salt if needed.
9. Serve hot in bowls with broth and vegetables.

title: Shankarpalli
instructions:
1. In a large bowl, mix flour, semolina, salt, and cardamom powder.
2. Add melted ghee and rub into flour until crumbly.
3. Add sugar and milk gradually to form a stiff dough.
4. Cover dough and rest for 20 minutes.
5. Divide dough into small balls and roll each into a 3 mm thick circle.
6. Cut circles into small diamonds or squares.
7. Heat oil to 160 C and fry shankarpalli in batches until light golden and crisp.
8. Drain on paper towels and cool completely.
9. Store in an airtight container.

title: Gajar Halwa
instructions:
1. Heat milk in a heavy pot and bring to a simmer.
2. Add grated carrots and cook on medium heat, stirring often, until carrots soften and milk reduces, about 30 minutes.
3. Add sugar and continue cooking until mixture thickens.
4. Add ghee and cook, stirring, until halwa leaves the sides of the pot.
5. Stir in cardamom powder, raisins, almonds, and pistachios.
6. Add khoya if using and cook 5 more minutes.
7. Taste and adjust sweetness.
8. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Apple Halwa
instructions:
1. Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a pan and roast semolina until fragrant. Set aside.
2. In the same pan, add grated apples and cook 5 minutes until soft.
3. Add milk and cook, stirring, until most liquid evaporates.
4. Add sugar and continue cooking until mixture thickens.
5. Add remaining ghee and cook until halwa leaves the sides of the pan.
6. Stir in roasted semolina, cardamom powder, raisins, and almonds.
7. Cook 2-3 minutes more.
8. Serve warm.

title: Badam Halwa
ingredients: 2 cups raw almonds, soaked in hot water for 2 hours
instructions:
1. Drain almonds and peel off skins.
2. Grind almonds with milk into a smooth paste.
3. Heat ghee in a heavy pan and add almond paste.
4. Cook on low heat, stirring constantly, for 10-12 minutes.
5. Add sugar and continue cooking until mixture thickens and leaves the sides of the pan.
6. Stir in cardamom powder and saffron milk if using.
7. Cook 2-3 minutes more until glossy.
8. Garnish with pistachios and serve warm.

title: Suji Halwa
instructions:
1. In a saucepan, combine water, sugar, cardamom, and saffron; bring to a boil and keep hot.
2. Heat ghee in a heavy pan over medium-low heat.
3. Add semolina and roast, stirring constantly, for 8-10 minutes until golden and nutty.
4. Carefully pour the hot syrup into the roasted semolina; it will bubble vigorously.
5. Stir continuously until the liquid is absorbed and the mixture thickens.
6. Cover and steam on low heat for 3-4 minutes.
7. Fold in almonds, raisins, and pistachios.
8. Serve warm in small bowls.

title: Ata Halwa
instructions:
1. In a saucepan, combine water, sugar, and cardamom; bring to a boil and keep hot.
2. Heat ghee in a heavy pan over medium-low heat.
3. Add whole wheat flour and roast, stirring constantly, for 12-15 minutes until dark golden and fragrant.
4. Carefully pour the hot syrup into the roasted flour; it will bubble.
5. Stir continuously until the liquid is absorbed and the halwa leaves the sides of the pan.
6. Cover and steam on low heat for 5 minutes.
7. Fold in almonds, pistachios, and raisins.
8. Serve warm.

title: Makhana Kheer
instructions:
1. Heat ghee in a pan and roast makhana for 3-4 minutes until crisp; crush coarsely.
2. Pour milk into a heavy pot and bring to a boil.
3. Add roasted makhana and simmer on low for 15 minutes.
4. Add sugar, almonds, pistachios, and raisins.
5. Add cardamom powder and saffron.
6. Simmer for 5-7 minutes until slightly thickened.
7. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Rice Kheer
instructions:
1. Rinse rice and soak for 20 minutes; drain well.
2. Pour milk into a heavy pot and bring to a boil.
3. Add rice and simmer on low for 45 minutes, stirring often.
4. Add sugar, almonds, pistachios, and raisins.
5. Add cardamom powder and saffron.
6. Simmer for 10 minutes until creamy and slightly thick.
7. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Sabudana Khichdi
instructions:
1. Rinse sabudana and soak for 4-5 hours until soft; drain well.
2. Boil potatoes, peel, and cut into small cubes.
3. Coarsely crush roasted peanuts.
4. Heat ghee in a pan and add cumin, curry leaves, and green chilies.
5. Add potatoes and sauté for 2 minutes.
6. Add sabudana, peanuts, salt, sugar, and lemon juice.
7. Toss gently until sabudana turns translucent.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

title: Poha
instructions:
1. Rinse poha in a sieve under running water until soft; drain completely.
2. Heat oil in a pan and fry peanuts until golden; set aside.
3. Add mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves, and green chilies to the same oil.
4. Add onion, potato, turmeric, and salt; cook for 5 minutes until potato is tender.
5. Add poha, sugar, lemon juice, and fried peanuts.
6. Toss gently on low heat for 2-3 minutes.
7. Garnish with coriander and serve warm.

title: Upma
instructions:
1. Dry roast rava in a pan until fragrant; set aside.
2. Heat ghee and add mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal, and curry leaves.
3. Add onion, green chilies, and ginger; sauté until soft.
4. Add carrot and peas; cook for 3 minutes.
5. Add water and salt; bring to a rolling boil.
6. Slowly add roasted rava while stirring to avoid lumps.
7. Cover and cook on low for 3-4 minutes.
8. Add lemon juice and coriander; fluff with a fork and serve.

title: Rava Upma
instructions:
1. Dry roast rava until light golden and fragrant; set aside.
2. Heat ghee and fry cashews until golden; set aside.
3. Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal, and curry leaves.
4. Add onion, green chilies, ginger, peas, and carrot; sauté for 3 minutes.
5. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
6. Slowly stir in roasted rava.
7. Cover and cook on low for 3 minutes.
8. Add fried cashews, lemon juice, and coriander; mix and serve.

title: Besan curry
instructions:
1. Whisk besan with yogurt and 1 cup water to make a lump-free slurry.
2. Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds and onion; fry until golden.
3. Add ginger garlic paste, tomatoes, turmeric, red chili, coriander, and salt.
4. Cook until tomatoes soften and oil separates.
5. Add besan slurry while stirring constantly.
6. Cook on low for 10-12 minutes, adding water for desired consistency.
7. Add garam masala and green chilies.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or roti.

title: Chilla With Daal
instructions:
1. Rinse dal and rice; soak for 4 hours.
2. Drain and grind with ginger, green chilies, cumin, salt, turmeric, and water to a pourable batter.
3. Rest the batter for 30 minutes.
4. Stir in coriander and optional onion.
5. Heat a non-stick pan and pour a ladle of batter; spread into a thin circle.
6. Drizzle oil around the edges and cook until the base lifts.
7. Flip and cook for 1-2 minutes.
8. Serve hot with chutney or yogurt.

title: Masoor Dal curry
instructions:
1. Rinse lentils and boil with turmeric and 3 cups water until soft.
2. Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds and onion; fry until golden.
3. Add ginger garlic paste, tomatoes, coriander, red chili, and salt.
4. Cook until tomatoes break down and oil separates.
5. Add cooked lentils and simmer for 10 minutes.
6. Add garam masala and green chilies.
7. Adjust water, then add lemon juice and coriander.
8. Serve hot with rice or roti.

title: MughDh Dal Bharta
instructions:
1. Rinse mung dal and boil with turmeric, salt, and water until soft but not mushy.
2. Drain excess water and mash lightly.
3. Heat mustard oil until smoking, then cool slightly.
4. Add panch phoron and dried red chili.
5. Add onion and green chilies; fry until soft.
6. Add mashed dal, sugar, and salt to taste.
7. Stir-cook for 5 minutes.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice.

title: Urad Dal fry
instructions:
1. Rinse and soak urad dal for 1 hour.
2. Boil with turmeric, salt, and water until soft.
3. Heat ghee and add cumin, ginger, and green chilies.
4. Add onion and fry until golden.
5. Add tomato and red chili; cook until soft.
6. Add cooked dal and simmer for 8 minutes.
7. Add garam masala, lemon juice, and coriander.
8. Serve with roti or rice.

title: Arhar Dal Gosht
instructions:
1. Rinse and soak arhar dal for 30 minutes.
2. Heat oil and fry onion until golden.
3. Add mutton, ginger garlic paste, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili, and salt; brown well.
4. Add tomatoes and cook until oil separates.
5. Add 3 cups water and pressure cook until mutton is tender.
6. Add soaked dal and remaining water; simmer until dal is soft.
7. Add garam masala and green chilies; simmer for 5 minutes.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or naan.

title: Dal Palak
instructions:
1. Rinse dal and boil with turmeric, salt, and water until soft.
2. Heat ghee and add cumin, garlic, onion, ginger, and green chilies.
3. Add tomato and cook until soft.
4. Add spinach and cook for 3-4 minutes.
5. Add cooked dal and simmer for 8 minutes.
6. Add garam masala and lemon juice.
7. Adjust salt and serve with rice or roti.

title: Dal Bhuna
instructions:
1. Rinse lentils and boil with turmeric, salt, and water until soft.
2. Heat mustard oil and fry onion until deep golden.
3. Add ginger garlic paste, tomatoes, cumin, coriander, and red chili.
4. Cook until oil separates.
5. Add cooked lentils and cook on high, stirring, until thick and bhuna.
6. Add garam masala and green chilies.
7. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice.

title: Mujaddara
instructions:
1. Rinse lentils and boil in 3 cups water until tender but not mushy.
2. Thinly slice onions.
3. Heat olive oil and fry onions until deep golden and crisp; reserve half.
4. Add rice, cumin, allspice, cinnamon, salt, and pepper to a pot.
5. Add cooked lentils and 2 cups water; bring to a boil.
6. Cover and simmer for 18 minutes.
7. Rest for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
8. Top with crispy onions and serve with yogurt.

title: Fasolia
instructions:
1. Drain soaked beans and boil in fresh water until tender.
2. Heat olive oil and brown beef cubes.
3. Add onion and garlic; sauté until soft.
4. Add tomato paste, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, allspice, salt, and pepper.
5. Add tomatoes and stock; simmer until beef is tender.
6. Add cooked beans and simmer for 20 minutes.
7. Adjust seasoning.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice.

title: Lablabi
instructions:
1. Drain chickpeas and boil in 8 cups water until very tender.
2. Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the broth.
3. Add garlic, cumin, coriander, harissa, and salt; simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Poach eggs in simmering water.
5. Toast bread and place in serving bowls.
6. Ladle chickpeas and broth over the bread.
7. Top with poached egg, tuna, capers, olive oil, lemon, and parsley.
8. Serve hot.

title: Shakshouka Tunisian
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a skillet.
2. Sauté onion and bell pepper until soft.
3. Add garlic, harissa, cumin, coriander, paprika, and tomato paste; cook for 1 minute.
4. Add tomatoes, salt, and pepper; simmer for 10-15 minutes.
5. Make four wells in the sauce.
6. Crack an egg into each well.
7. Cover and cook until egg whites set but yolks are still soft.
8. Garnish with parsley and serve with bread.

title: Brik
ingredients: 4 sheets malsouka or spring roll wrappers
instructions:
1. Mix tuna, onion, parsley, capers, mashed potato, salt, and pepper.
2. Lay one wrapper on a plate.
3. Place 2 tbsp filling in the center, make a well, and crack an egg into it.
4. Fold the wrapper into a triangle, sealing the edges carefully.
5. Heat oil in a deep pan for shallow frying.
6. Fry brik for 1-2 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
7. Drain on paper towels.
8. Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

title: Couscous Chicken
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown chicken pieces.
2. Add onion and garlic; sauté until soft.
3. Stir in tomato paste, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, ginger, salt, and pepper.
4. Add tomatoes and chicken stock; simmer for 30 minutes.
5. Add carrots and turnip; simmer for 15 minutes.
6. Add zucchini and chickpeas; simmer for 10 minutes.
7. Prepare couscous by steaming or soaking in hot stock, then fluff.
8. Serve chicken and vegetables over couscous with broth and coriander.

title: Chakhchoukha
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil and brown lamb or chicken.
2. Add onion and garlic; sauté until soft.
3. Add tomato paste, harissa, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and pepper.
4. Add tomatoes and stock; simmer until meat is tender.
5. Add chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
6. Tear flatbread into a large bowl.
7. Ladle hot stew over bread and let soak for 5 minutes.
8. Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Msemen
instructions:
1. Mix flour, semolina, salt, sugar, yeast, and warm water.
2. Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
3. Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
4. Divide into balls; coat with oil and rest for 15 minutes.
5. Flatten each ball thinly, brush with butter and oil, and sprinkle with semolina.
6. Fold into a square, then flatten again.
7. Cook on a hot griddle until golden on both sides.
8. Serve warm with honey or tea.

title: Baghrir
instructions:
1. Blend semolina, flour, yeast, baking powder, salt, sugar, water, egg, and melted butter until smooth.
2. Cover and rest for 30 minutes until bubbly.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
4. Pour a ladle of batter; do not spread.
5. Cook only one side until holes form and the top is set.
6. Do not flip; remove carefully.
7. Stack and keep warm.
8. Serve with honey-butter.

title: Harira Soup
ingredients: 250 g halal lamb or beef, cut into small cubes
8 cups water or halal beef stock
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, celery, and carrot; cook 5 minutes until softened.
2. Add lamb or beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 6 minutes.
3. Stir in turmeric, cinnamon, ginger, paprika, black pepper, and cayenne; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
4. Add blended tomatoes, tomato paste, lentils, chickpeas, and water or stock. Bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 35-40 minutes until lentils and meat are tender.
6. Add vermicelli and simmer 8-10 minutes until noodles are soft.
7. Stir in cilantro and parsley, then season with salt to taste.
8. Simmer 2 more minutes, adjust consistency with hot water if needed, and serve hot with lemon wedges.

title: Moroccan Tajine Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg halal chicken thighs, bone-in and skinless
1/4 tsp saffron threads, soaked in 2 tbsp warm water
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions:
1. Pat chicken dry and season with salt and black pepper.
2. Heat olive oil in a heavy pot or tajine over medium heat. Brown chicken on both sides, then set aside.
3. Add onions to the same pot and cook until soft and golden, about 6 minutes.
4. Stir in garlic, ginger, turmeric, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, paprika, and saffron water; cook 1 minute.
5. Return chicken to the pot, add stock, preserved lemon, and olives. Bring to a simmer.
6. Cover and cook on low for 35-40 minutes until chicken is tender.
7. Uncover and simmer 10 minutes to thicken the sauce slightly.
8. Stir in cilantro and parsley, adjust salt, and serve hot with couscous or bread.

title: Sri Lankan Kukul Mas Curry
ingredients: 1 kg halal chicken, cut into medium pieces
1 pandan leaf, tied in a knot
2 tbsp Sri Lankan roasted curry powder
instructions:
1. Heat coconut oil in a clay pot or heavy pan. Add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, curry leaves, pandan leaf, and onions.
2. Saute until onions are golden, about 5 minutes.
3. Add garlic, ginger, green chilies, curry powder, turmeric, chili powder, and black pepper; cook 1 minute.
4. Add chicken pieces and toss well to coat with spices.
5. Pour in 1/2 cup water, cover, and simmer 20 minutes until chicken is partly cooked.
6. Add coconut milk and tamarind paste. Stir and simmer uncovered 15-20 minutes until chicken is tender.
7. Taste and add salt. Cook until oil separates slightly and gravy is thick.
8. Rest 5 minutes and serve with rice, pol roti, or string hoppers.

title: Pol Roti
ingredients: 3/4 cup water, plus extra if needed
2 tbsp coconut oil or vegetable oil for cooking
instructions:
1. In a large bowl, mix all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, grated coconut, onion, green chilies, curry leaves, and salt.
2. Add water gradually and knead into a soft, slightly sticky dough.
3. Cover dough and rest 20 minutes.
4. Divide dough into 8 equal balls.
5. Flatten each ball on a lightly floured surface into a round roti about 1/4 inch thick.
6. Heat a griddle over medium heat and cook each roti 2-3 minutes per side until browned spots appear.
7. Brush with a little coconut oil or oil and cook 30 seconds more per side.
8. Serve warm with curry, sambol, or plain yogurt.

title: Kukul Koththu
ingredients: 2 Sri Lankan godhamba roti or paratha, shredded
instructions:
1. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large pan. Add curry leaves, onion, green chilies, and ginger garlic paste; fry 2 minutes.
2. Add chicken, curry powder, chili powder, turmeric, and salt. Cook 6-8 minutes until chicken is done.
3. Push chicken to one side, crack eggs into the pan, and scramble until just set.
4. Add tomatoes and cook 2 minutes until softened.
5. Add shredded roti and remaining oil. Toss everything together over high heat.
6. Chop and mix continuously with two spatulas or a koththu blade for 3-4 minutes.
7. Taste and adjust salt and chili. Squeeze lime juice over the top.
8. Serve hot with extra lime wedges and sambol.

title: Sri Lankan Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Scramble eggs, then remove and set aside.
2. Add remaining oil, then onion, green chilies, leeks, carrot, and cabbage. Stir-fry 3 minutes.
3. Add chicken and prawns; cook 5-6 minutes until chicken is done and prawns are pink.
4. Stir in ginger garlic paste, curry powder, chili paste, and soy sauce.
5. Add cooked rice and toss well, breaking up any lumps.
6. Return scrambled eggs to the wok and mix through.
7. Season with salt and stir-fry 2-3 minutes until everything is hot.
8. Serve immediately with lime wedges or a fried egg on top.

title: Nasi Lemak
ingredients: Sambal: 10 dried red chilies, soaked in hot water
instructions:
1. Place rice, coconut milk, water, pandan leaf, lemongrass, and salt in a rice cooker or pot.
2. Cook until rice is tender and fragrant. Fluff and keep warm.
3. For sambal, blend soaked chilies, shallots, and garlic into a coarse paste.
4. Heat oil in a pan and fry the sambal paste over medium heat until fragrant, about 5 minutes.
5. Add tamarind paste, sugar, and salt. Cook 5-7 minutes until thick and glossy.
6. Arrange coconut rice on plates with cucumber, boiled eggs, fried anchovies, and peanuts.
7. Spoon sambal over or beside the rice.
8. Serve warm as a complete meal.

title: Rendang Duck
ingredients: 1 kg halal duck, cut into pieces
100 g grated coconut, toasted until golden
instructions:
1. Blend shallots, garlic, red chilies, candlenuts, ginger, galangal, and turmeric into a smooth paste.
2. Heat oil in a heavy pot. Fry spice paste with lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves for 5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Add duck pieces and cook 5 minutes, turning to coat with spices.
4. Pour in coconut milk and add tamarind paste, palm sugar, and salt.
5. Bring to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to low.
6. Cook uncovered 60-75 minutes, stirring occasionally, until duck is tender and liquid reduces.
7. Add toasted grated coconut and continue cooking 15-20 minutes until sauce is thick and dark.
8. Stir often near the end to prevent burning; the rendang should be almost dry.
9. Rest 10 minutes and serve with steamed rice.

title: Bakso Ayam
instructions:
1. In a food processor, blend ground chicken, garlic, salt, white pepper, and egg white until smooth.
2. Add tapioca starch and baking powder; pulse to combine.
3. With the processor running, slowly add ice water until the mixture is sticky and smooth.
4. Chill the mixture 20 minutes, then shape into small balls with wet hands.
5. Bring a large pot of water to a gentle simmer. Drop in meatballs and cook until they float, about 8-10 minutes.
6. Remove meatballs and set aside. For broth, simmer chicken stock with garlic, white pepper, and salt for 15 minutes.
7. Add cooked noodles to serving bowls, then top with meatballs and hot broth.
8. Garnish with spring onions, fried shallots, sambal, and lime.

title: Soto Ayam
ingredients: 1 kg halal chicken, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Boil chicken with water, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and bay leaves in a large pot for 30 minutes.
2. Remove chicken, shred the meat, and strain the broth. Keep broth hot.
3. Blend shallots, garlic, candlenuts, turmeric, coriander, and cumin into a paste.
4. Heat oil in a pan and fry the paste 5 minutes until fragrant.
5. Add fried paste to the broth and simmer 10 minutes. Season with salt.
6. Arrange vermicelli, potatoes, bean sprouts, shredded chicken, and eggs in serving bowls.
7. Pour hot broth over the toppings.
8. Garnish with fried shallots, lime wedges, and sambal.
9. Serve immediately.

title: Ayam Geprek
ingredients: 500 g halal chicken breast, sliced thin
instructions:
1. Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder in a bowl.
2. Dip chicken slices in beaten egg, then coat well in the flour mixture.
3. Heat oil in a deep pan over medium-high heat.
4. Fry chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
5. For sambal, pound or blend red chilies, bird's eye chilies, garlic, and tomato into a coarse paste.
6. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan and fry sambal paste 5 minutes. Add sugar, salt, and lime juice.
7. Place fried chicken on a plate and smash it lightly with the back of a spoon.
8. Spoon sambal over the chicken and serve with warm rice.

title: Beef Rendang
ingredients: 100 g grated coconut, toasted until golden
Spice paste: 10 dried red chilies, soaked
instructions:
1. Blend shallots, garlic, soaked chilies, candlenuts, ginger, galangal, and turmeric into a smooth paste.
2. Heat oil in a heavy pot. Fry spice paste, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves for 5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Add beef cubes and cook 5 minutes, stirring to coat with spices.
4. Pour in coconut milk and add tamarind paste, palm sugar, and salt.
5. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low.
6. Cook uncovered 90 minutes, stirring occasionally, until beef is tender and sauce reduces.
7. Add toasted grated coconut and cook 20-30 minutes more until sauce is thick and dark.
8. Stir frequently near the end to prevent burning; rendang should be almost dry.
9. Rest 10 minutes and serve with steamed rice.

title: Ayam Bakar
instructions:
1. Blend shallots, garlic, red chilies, ginger, galangal, turmeric, coriander, and cumin into a paste.
2. Heat oil in a pan and fry the paste with lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves for 4 minutes.
3. Add sweet soy sauce, tamarind paste, palm sugar, salt, and coconut milk. Simmer 5 minutes.
4. Add chicken thighs and coat well in the sauce. Cover and cook 20 minutes until chicken is tender.
5. Remove chicken and continue simmering sauce until slightly thick.
6. Grill chicken over charcoal or in a grill pan, basting with the sauce.
7. Turn and baste until both sides are caramelized and cooked through.
8. Serve hot with remaining sauce, rice, and fresh vegetables.

title: Sate Lilit
instructions:
1. Blend shallots, garlic, red chilies, turmeric, coriander, and galangal into a paste.
2. In a bowl, mix ground chicken, grated coconut, coconut milk, spice paste, chopped lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, palm sugar, and salt.
3. Knead the mixture until sticky and well combined.
4. Chill 15 minutes for easier shaping.
5. Wet hands and mold about 2 tbsp of mixture around each lemongrass skewer.
6. Heat a grill pan or charcoal grill and lightly oil it.
7. Grill satay 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through and lightly charred.
8. Serve hot with peanut sauce, rice, or cucumber relish.

title: Mee Goreng
instructions:
1. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Scramble eggs, then remove and set aside.
2. Add remaining oil, then garlic, shallots, and red chilies. Stir-fry 1 minute.
3. Add chicken and prawns; cook 4-5 minutes until chicken is done and prawns are pink.
4. Add cabbage and tomato; stir-fry 2 minutes.
5. Add soy sauce, sweet soy sauce, chili paste, and curry powder.
6. Add cooked noodles and toss well to coat evenly.
7. Return scrambled eggs and mix through. Cook 2 minutes more.
8. Serve hot with lime wedges.

title: Maggi Masala
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Let them sizzle.
2. Add onion, green chili, carrots, and peas. Saute 3 minutes.
3. Add tomato, turmeric, red chili powder, and garam masala. Cook 2 minutes until soft.
4. Pour in water and bring to a boil.
5. Add Maggi noodles and the tastemaker packets.
6. Cook 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until noodles are tender and water is mostly absorbed.
7. Garnish with cilantro and serve hot.

title: Chicken Nihari Karachi
ingredients: 1 kg halal chicken, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Heat oil or ghee in a heavy pot. Fry onions until deep golden brown.
2. Add ginger garlic paste and chicken. Cook 8 minutes until chicken changes color.
3. Stir in red chili powder, turmeric, and nihari masala. Cook 2 minutes.
4. Add 3 cups water, cover, and simmer 30 minutes until chicken is tender.
5. Whisk flour with remaining 1 cup water until smooth.
6. Slowly add flour slurry to the pot, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
7. Simmer uncovered 15-20 minutes until gravy thickens and oil separates.
8. Season with salt and adjust consistency with hot water if needed.
9. Garnish with ginger, green chilies, cilantro, and lemon wedges. Serve with naan.

title: Beef Biryani Dum Style
instructions:
1. Heat oil or ghee in a pot. Fry onions until golden, then remove half for layering.
2. Add beef, ginger garlic paste, and whole spices. Cook 8 minutes until browned.
3. Add yogurt, tomatoes, red chili powder, turmeric, biryani masala, and salt. Cook until oil separates.
4. Add 1 cup water, cover, and simmer 60-75 minutes until beef is tender.
5. Meanwhile, boil rice with salt and whole spices until 70 percent cooked. Drain.
6. In a heavy pot, layer beef curry, then rice, fried onions, mint, cilantro, and green chilies.
7. Warm milk with saffron and drizzle over the top.
8. Cover with a tight lid or seal with dough. Cook on low heat for 20 minutes for dum.
9. Rest 10 minutes, then gently fluff and serve with raita.

title: Pakistani Karai Gosht
ingredients: 1 kg halal beef or mutton, cubed
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a karahi or wok. Add onions and fry until golden.
2. Add beef or mutton and ginger garlic paste. Cook on high heat 8 minutes.
3. Add tomatoes, coriander, cumin, red chili powder, turmeric, and salt.
4. Cover and cook on low 60-75 minutes until meat is tender, adding water if needed.
5. Uncover and increase heat to dry excess moisture.
6. Add yogurt and green chilies. Cook 8-10 minutes until oil separates.
7. Stir in garam masala and cook 2 minutes.
8. Garnish with cilantro and ginger. Serve with naan.

title: Mutton White Karahi
instructions:
1. Heat ghee or oil in a karahi. Add onions and fry until soft and lightly golden.
2. Add mutton and ginger garlic paste. Cook on high heat 8 minutes.
3. Add 1 cup water, cover, and simmer 70-90 minutes until mutton is tender.
4. Uncover and cook until water dries and oil separates.
5. Add yogurt, white pepper, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and salt.
6. Cook 8-10 minutes, stirring, until yogurt is absorbed.
7. Add cream and green chilies. Simmer 5 minutes.
8. Sprinkle garam masala, garnish with cilantro and ginger, and serve with naan.

title: Chicken White Karahi
ingredients: 1 kg halal chicken, cut into pieces
instructions:
1. Heat oil or ghee in a karahi. Add onions and fry until soft and lightly golden.
2. Add chicken and ginger garlic paste. Cook on high heat 6-8 minutes.
3. Add 1/2 cup water, cover, and simmer 20 minutes until chicken is tender.
4. Uncover and cook until water dries and oil separates.
5. Add yogurt, white pepper, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and salt.
6. Cook 6-8 minutes, stirring, until yogurt is absorbed.
7. Add cream and green chilies. Simmer 5 minutes.
8. Sprinkle garam masala, garnish with cilantro and ginger, and serve with naan.

title: Makhani Daal
ingredients: 1 cup black urad dal, soaked 6 hours
instructions:
1. Drain urad dal and kidney beans. Boil in 5 cups water until very soft, about 45-60 minutes.
2. Mash some of the dal with the back of a spoon to thicken.
3. Heat butter in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle.
4. Add onion, ginger garlic paste, and green chilies. Cook until onion is golden.
5. Add tomato puree, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt. Cook 8 minutes until oil separates.
6. Add the cooked dal mixture and simmer 15 minutes.
7. Stir in cream and simmer 5 minutes.
8. Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Daal Mash
ingredients: 1 cup white urad dal, soaked 2 hours
instructions:
1. Drain dal and boil in 4 cups water until soft but not mushy, about 25-30 minutes.
2. Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and onion; fry until golden.
3. Add ginger garlic paste, tomatoes, green chilies, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt.
4. Cook 8 minutes until tomatoes soften and oil separates.
5. Add boiled dal with its water and simmer 10 minutes.
6. Mash lightly with a spoon to thicken the dal.
7. Stir in garam masala and simmer 2 minutes.
8. Garnish with cilantro and ginger. Serve with roti or rice.

title: Charga (Multani)
ingredients: 1 whole halal chicken, about 1.5 kg, skin on
instructions:
1. Prick chicken all over with a fork. Mix yogurt, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander, cumin, garam masala, black pepper, lemon juice, and salt.
2. Coat chicken well with the marinade, inside and out. Cover and refrigerate 6-8 hours or overnight.
3. Steam or bake chicken at 180 C for 25 minutes until partly cooked. Set aside to cool slightly.
4. Mix gram flour with 2 tbsp water to make a thin batter.
5. Heat oil in a deep pot for frying.
6. Coat the partly cooked chicken with gram flour batter.
7. Carefully deep fry chicken until golden brown and fully cooked, turning as needed.
8. Drain on paper towels.
9. Sprinkle chaat masala and serve hot with naan, salad, and mint chutney.

title: Multani Kahwa
instructions:
1. Bring water to a boil in a kettle or saucepan.
2. Add green tea leaves, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and fennel seeds.
3. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes until fragrant.
4. Add saffron threads and sugar or honey. Stir until dissolved.
5. Strain the kahwa into cups or a teapot.
6. Garnish with almonds and pistachios. Serve hot.

title: Sokha Chicken
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pot and fry onions until golden.
2. Add chicken and sear until color changes.
3. Add ginger garlic paste, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili, and salt.
4. Stir in yogurt and cook until oil separates.
5. Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
6. Cover and cook on low until chicken is tender and moisture dries.
7. Add green chilies and garam masala.
8. Cook 2 minutes, garnish with coriander, and serve.

title: Chiniot Beef Tikkia
instructions:
1. Boil soaked chana dal until soft but not mushy, then drain.
2. Grind dal coarsely without water.
3. Mix beef mince, ground dal, onion, ginger garlic, green chilies, coriander, mint, and all spices.
4. Knead well for 5 minutes until sticky.
5. Shape into flat round tikkia patties.
6. Heat oil in a pan for shallow frying.
7. Fry patties on medium heat until browned and cooked through, about 4 minutes per side.
8. Drain on paper and serve hot with chutney.

title: Chinioti Pulao
instructions:
1. Heat oil and fry onions until golden.
2. Add mutton and brown well.
3. Add ginger garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili, and salt.
4. Stir in yogurt and cook until oil separates.
5. Add water, whole spices, and simmer until mutton is tender.
6. Add potatoes and green chilies, then cook until potatoes are almost done.
7. Parboil soaked rice in salted water until 70 percent cooked, then drain.
8. Layer rice over mutton, cover, and cook on low dum for 20 minutes.
9. Fluff gently and serve.

title: Karahi Fish
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a karahi and lightly fry fish chunks.
2. Remove fish and set aside.
3. Add cumin, ginger, and garlic to the same oil.
4. Add tomatoes, coriander, turmeric, red chili, and salt.
5. Cook until tomatoes soften and oil separates.
6. Add fish and green chilies gently.
7. Cover and simmer 5-7 minutes until fish is cooked.
8. Sprinkle garam masala and coriander, then serve.

title: Fisherdda
instructions:
1. Boil red lentils with turmeric and salt until soft.
2. Heat mustard oil in a pan and fry onion until golden.
3. Add ginger garlic, cumin, coriander, red chili, and salt.
4. Add fish pieces and cook gently 3 minutes per side.
5. Add boiled lentils and 1 cup water.
6. Simmer 10 minutes until fish is cooked and flavors blend.
7. Add green chilies and coriander.
8. Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Fish Charga
ingredients: 1 kg whole fish or thick fillets
instructions:
1. Mix yogurt, ginger garlic, red chili, turmeric, garam masala, cumin, coriander, lemon juice, and salt.
2. Coat fish well and marinate 2 hours.
3. Steam fish in a covered steamer for 10 minutes.
4. Cool slightly and dust with gram flour.
5. Heat oil for deep frying.
6. Fry fish until golden and crisp.
7. Drain on paper.
8. Serve with lemon and salad.

title: Fish Karahi
instructions:
1. Heat oil and lightly fry fish pieces, then remove.
2. Add cumin and onions, fry until golden.
3. Add ginger garlic, coriander, turmeric, red chili, and salt.
4. Add tomatoes and cook until soft and oil separates.
5. Add fish and green chilies gently.
6. Cover and simmer 6-8 minutes.
7. Add kasuri methi and garam masala.
8. Garnish with coriander and serve.

title: Tandoori Fish
instructions:
1. Mix yogurt, tandoori masala, red chili, turmeric, ginger garlic, lemon juice, mustard oil, and salt.
2. Coat fish fillets with marinade.
3. Marinate 1 hour in refrigerator.
4. Preheat oven to 220 C or heat grill.
5. Thread fish onto skewers or place on a lined tray.
6. Grill 8-10 minutes, turning once.
7. Baste with oil and grill 2 more minutes.
8. Serve hot with lemon and onion rings.

title: Beef Ularth
ingredients: 500 g beef, cut into small pieces
instructions:
1. Pressure cook beef with turmeric and salt until tender.
2. Heat coconut oil and add curry leaves.
3. Add onions and fry until golden.
4. Add ginger garlic, red chili, coriander, black pepper, and salt.
5. Add cooked beef and toss well.
6. Add coconut slices.
7. Roast on medium heat until beef is dry and dark.
8. Sprinkle garam masala and serve.

title: Ara Beef Cury
instructions:
1. Heat mustard oil and fry onions until deep golden.
2. Add ginger garlic, turmeric, red chili, coriander, cumin, and salt.
3. Add beef and sear until browned.
4. Stir in yogurt and cook until oil separates.
5. Add 2 cups water and bring to a boil.
